I've been using the Celimax Ji.Woo.Gae Heartleaf BHA Peeling Pads for a 4 years now, and they've quickly become one of my favorite skincare staples. The first thing I noticed is how smooth it leaves my skin, I also have a glow and they don't sting or irritate my skin at all. Instead, they provide a mild, refreshing exfoliation that leaves my face feeling clean and smooth. The heartleaf ingredient really stands out. My skin tends to get a bit sensitive and red, especially around my cheeks, but these pads help calm everything down while still keeping my pores clear. I've also seen a noticeable improvement in texture—my skin looks more even, and those small clogged pores on my nose and chin have reduced significantly. Another big plus is the convenience. The pads are well-soaked but not dripping, and the dual texture makes them versatile—one side gently exfoliates, while the other helps smooth and prep the skin. They're perfect for both morning and nighttime routines. Overall, I'd highly recommend these peeling pads if you're looking for something effective yet gentle. They strike a great balance between exfoliation and soothing care, making them suitable even for sensitive skin types.
So far I love this product. Used at bedtime, made skin mildly red, woke up with visibly improved texture. Skin is much smoother and not so dull.
